subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder, blade pointing back
description: a heavy, far-reaching horizontal sword sweep to the right: he hauls the gigantic greatsword off his shoulder and draws it back behind him, takes a big step forward to the right, then swings it in one wide flat arc in front of him with BOTH ARMS FULLY STRETCHED OUT, so the long blade reaches far out to the right, using the empty space on the right side of the picture; the blade stays far from his body at full reach through the swing, then he follows through, pulls the sword back and rests it on his shoulder again.
